utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Hey Cleo, I keep hearing the repair drive's been switched to Sunday at the community center—does that sound right to you?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: What? I’ve been planning for Saturday on my front porch. Let me double-check—I don’t think it moved.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: I'm pretty sure Rosa told me it's Sunday at the community center now—maybe there was a mix-up?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Yes, that's right. The repair drive is now Sunday at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Sunday at the community center? I'll try to be there, but I've got a few things weighing on me right now.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Take your time, Uli. We'll be there from noon until four, so just come when you can.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: So, when's the repair drive actually starting? I've got a broken fence post that's been waiting weeks.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I'm not sure on the exact date—I heard it's soon though. Maybe Jules can tell us more when we see her.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Do you know if Jules is around now? I'd like to nail down a time so I can plan my weekend.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Yeah Noah, Saturday morning. If you find that wrench, bring it along.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Wrench? I think I left it in the garage, but I'll check. Can you remind me of the time again?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Sure, 9 AM at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Hey Tess! I'm glad I ran into you—I'm organizing a repair drive this Saturday at my front porch. Could really use a hand if you're free.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh Ira, I think there's been a change! I heard it's moved to Sunday at the community center now.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Wait, really? I thought it was still Saturday at my porch. Where did you hear that?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Wait, Jules just told me it's a repair drive—bikes, appliances, even a water pump. You sure it's a clean-up?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Yeah Bo, it's definitely a repair drive. I've got my wrenches ready to go.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Alright, got it—repair drive. I'll grab my tool kit and swing by if I can.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right, the repair drive! I think that's what they said... or was it a clean-up? I can't quite remember.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: It's this Saturday at my front porch. We're fixing old bikes and electronics—want to lend a hand?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, fixing bikes and electronics? Count me in! I think I have an old radio somewhere...

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Faye, did you get the go-ahead from the principal for the school lot?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Not yet, but since it's moved to Sunday at the community center now, I'll check with them about using the lot for overflow parking or setup.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Oh good thinking, Faye! The community center is a solid spot, and having the school lot as backup could really help if we get a big turnout.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I was thinking 10 AM would give us time to sort parking before folks start arriving. Think that works?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Yes, 10 AM on Sunday at the community center sounds perfect—I'll let everyone know about the time change.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Wait, I thought it was Saturday at my front porch? I'm a bit confused now—did we switch both the day and the location?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Hey Sam! I'm glad you're interested in the repair drive — we're getting a great group together to fix up bikes, appliances, and even a water pump. Want to hear more about it?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sure thing, Jules! I'm happy to help with fixing appliances or whatever you need most.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: That's awesome, Sam! We're planning to start this weekend, and I'll put you down for appliances. I'll send you the details later today.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: The repair drive is this Saturday at 9 AM sharp on my front porch. I need helpers, so if you're free, come on by.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Wait, so is it actually a repair drive? I thought we were just cleaning up this Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Oh, no, Kira—it's definitely a repair drive. We're fixing things for folks like Mina's fence post, not just cleaning up.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Yes, it's definitely a repair drive this Saturday! We're fixing things up around the neighborhood — tools and snacks provided.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Great, I'll bring my old bike then. See you Saturday!

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Perfect, Hana! I'll add you to the list — we're going to have a great turnout.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: So just to be clear, Sam—this repair drive covers personal items too, right? Not just the community center stuff?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely, Hana! Bring anything that needs fixing—lamps, toasters, chairs, whatever you've got. I'll be there to help out.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Great, that's what I thought—I'll bring my old bike then. See you Saturday morning!

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: So, when’s the repair drive actually starting? I’ve got a broken fence post that’s been waiting weeks.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: It's actually been moved to Sunday at the community center, so that fence post can finally get some love.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Sunday? Well, that's better than never. Will there be someone who knows how to set a post properly, or is it just a free-for-all?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Right, the repair drive. I could probably lend a hand with some small fixes.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, great! It's this Saturday, right? Or was it Sunday? I keep mixing it up.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Saturday, I think. But honestly, I'm not sure I'll be much help.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Oh, a repair drive! I think I have some spare parts in my garage. Want me to check what I have that might be useful?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: A repair drive? Oh, right, on Saturday the 15th! That sounds great, Cleo—I'd appreciate you looking through your garage, I keep misplacing my good tools.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I'll dig through my spare parts tonight and bring what I find to the porch on Saturday. Always happy to help out!

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Hey Jules, are you in for the repair drive this Saturday? I'm rallying the whole neighborhood!

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Absolutely, Quinn! I've already got Nell and Hana interested — let's grab coffee and map out who else we can tap.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Perfect, Jules! Let's hit The Daily Grind at 10 — I'll bring my list of folks who owe me a favor.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, Dane, did you hear? The repair drive got moved to Sunday at the community center instead of Saturday on the porch. Jerry's still donating tools!

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Yeah, I just caught wind of that change. Sunday works better for me anyway—I can finally bring that wrench set I've been meaning to donate.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, that's great to hear! More tools mean we can fix even more things—I'm already thinking of bringing my old toaster.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Cleo, that would be wonderful! Please do check your garage—I want to make sure we have enough nails and brackets before Saturday so nothing stalls.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: I'll check my garage for nails and brackets too. Also, Gus reminded me I still have his drill—I'll bring that for the drive.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Alright Leo, just make sure you've got a full inventory before Saturday—I don't want us scrambling mid-repair because someone forgot a bracket.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Hey Rey, glad you're here. I just wanted to confirm—the repair drive has been moved to Sunday at the community center, right?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Oh, I thought it was still Saturday on my front porch. Did I miss an announcement?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Yes, it was changed earlier today — we moved it to Sunday at the community center. I've been making sure everyone knows.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Hey Vik, I keep hearing people talk about the repair drive but I'm still fuzzy on the details—what's actually happening with it?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Oh, it's this Saturday the 15th! Cleo is checking her garage for spare parts, and I'm bringing my old toaster to fix up.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: That sounds great! Do you need any help with the toaster or setting up?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Eli, just a quick update—the repair drive has been moved to Sunday at the community center instead of Saturday at the front porch. Hope you can still make it!

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Oh, I see—Sunday at the community center, huh? I had my whole Saturday mapped out, but I can adjust. Guess I'll bring my toolbox along.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: That's great to hear, Eli—your toolbox will definitely come in handy! I'll put you down for Sunday.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Hey Kira! Just got word about the repair drive—it's this Saturday at 9 AM on the front porch. Bring any tools you can spare!

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Hold on, are we definitely doing repairs? I'm still not sure if it's a clean-up or a repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Yes, it's definitely a repair drive! The community center is lending us the front porch for fixing things together.
